rationale: The assistant told the customer to stop use and unplug, correctly identified the burnt waveguide cover, and advised replacing it and cleaning the cavity. It warned against opening the casing and set escalation only if sparking persists. Minor issues: it said 'a few pounds or dollars', it suggested testing with a mug of water, and it was somewhat vague in implying a possible 'magnetron' issue. In the second turn it also did not strongly repeat 'stop use until replaced', although it did say not to use without a cover. Advising that a mica sheet can be cut to size is acceptable per the ground truth.
